metadata.description: Banking-grade transaction intelligence configuration with entity normalization, fuzzy matching, and confidence scoring. v5.0 adds CURATED_* Indian merchant/utility/tax/insurance/charge groups and extended UPI handles. v5.1 adds direction-correct CASH_OPERATIONS, PAYMENT_AGGREGATORS, CURATED_GAMING and CHEQUE_OPERATIONS groups, fused Bajaj Finance aliases, six regex pattern_detection families (not yet wired), and marks configuration sections no engine reads with implemented=false.

superseded_flat_aliases._note: Same alias re-declared in a v5.1 group at higher priority; the original entry is kept but no longer wins. Old category shown.

pattern_detection_wiring.syntax: Python re, lowercase, matched with re.search (NOT the substring 'p in text' used for the legacy keys). Boundaries use (?<![a-z0-9]) / (?![a-z0-9]) so '_' and punctuation count as separators.
pattern_detection_wiring.match_against: both the normalised description and the raw lowercase description - text_normalization.strip_patterns 'upi.*id.*' erases whole UPI narrations that contain 'id' anywhere after 'upi'.

cheque_patterns._dd_override: demand-draft matches: debit DEMAND_DRAFT, credit REFUND

category_normalization.description: Maps all internal words.json category codes to canonical display names

rules: Entity interpretation overrides all other classifications
Direction rule overrides generic keyword when entity is detected
Entity alias match has priority over standalone keywords
Exact keyword match preferred over fuzzy match
Longer keyword match preferred over shorter
Higher confidence score wins within same group
Group priority order breaks ties across groups
High confidence keywords override low confidence
Pattern match used as supporting evidence, not primary classifier

behavior_context.description: Behavioral pattern detection for ML integration - configuration only, no implementation

feedback_learning.description: User feedback and learning system - configuration only, no implementation

entity_interpretation._description: Entity-based classification that runs BEFORE keyword matching
entity_interpretation._usage: Match entity name in transaction narration, then apply credit/debit interpretation

TERMINAL_SETTLEMENTS._description: Generic terminal card settlement events. Direction-aware: credit = business income (merchant payout/settlement), debit = business expense (card settlement from customer).

classification._description: Keyword-based classification from original words.json - use for non-entity matching

BUSINESS_VENDORS._description: Generic business vendor detection based on company suffixes. Direction-aware: credit=business income, debit=business expense.

SALARY_PAYMENTS._description: Salary payments. Direction-aware: credit=salary income, debit=salary expense (business paying salary).

ATW_TRANSACTIONS._description: ATW (At The Window) - Cash transactions at bank branch counter. Both credit and debit are bank transfers with cash group.

NEFT_TRANSACTIONS._description: NEFT - Digital bank transfers. Both credit and debit use digital transfer group.

INSURANCE_TRANSACTIONS._description: Insurance transactions. Direction-aware: credit=insurance claim/payout, debit=insurance premium payment.

CASH_OPERATIONS._description: v5.1 Cash deposits/withdrawals, direction-correct. Priority 75 deliberately supersedes the flat (same category both directions) CURATED_FIXED cash aliases re-declared here. Deposit phrases: credit=Cash Deposit, debit=Bank Charges. Withdrawal phrases: debit=ATM Withdrawal (platform convention for all cash withdrawals), credit=Refund. Self-cash phrases: credit=Cash Deposit, debit=ATM Withdrawal. Never add bare 'cash' or 'self' (cashback, cashfree, cashe, self transfer).

PAYMENT_AGGREGATORS._description: v5.1 Payment aggregators / BC rails seen fused into narrations (FN/SHP/N/ <MERCHANT>_BHARTIPAY SERV, BAN/PAYMENT/ IFT/PBN/ONE97). credit=merchant settlement (Business Income), debit=Transfer; one97 (Paytm) mirrors PAYMENT_PLATFORMS.paytm. 'by cashfree' is a guard so the CASH_OPERATIONS 'by cash' alias cannot capture Cashfree payouts; it mirrors PAYMENT_GATEWAYS.cashfree. NOTE: GenericRuleEngine tiers groups by hard-coded name, so this group is tier 0 (merchant tier) until '_rails' includes it.

CURATED_GAMING._description: v5.1 Real-money gaming, fantasy and betting operators (underwriting risk signal). credit=Gaming Winnings, debit=Gaming. Priority 70 supersedes CURATED_ENTERTAINMENT for dream11/my11circle. Deliberately excluded: bare 'fantasy', 'howzat', 'stake' (shop/business-name collisions) and bare 'mpl' (stays Entertainment; 3-letter acronym too ambiguous to label as gaming).

CHEQUE_OPERATIONS._description: v5.1 Cheque / demand-draft instruments, direction-correct: credit=Cheque Deposit, debit=Cheque Issued (labels consumed by finbit_analytics chqDeposit/chqIssues). Demand drafts: debit=Demand Draft, credit=Refund (cancelled DD). 'cheque bk' is the cheque-book charge. Priority 75 supersedes the flat CURATED_FIXED Transfer entries re-declared here. Bare 'cheque:'/'chq:' deliberately NOT an alias (Canara prints CHQ: fragments on non-cheque rows - see pattern_detection.cheque_patterns note).
